findings.title: SSRF via tenant-controlled WhatsWay base URL
findings.recommendation: Require HTTPS and a provider allowlist; route all requests through safeFetch with pinned DNS and no redirects.

findings.title: Operational credentials stored as plaintext
findings.recommendation: Encrypt on write using APP_KEY, decrypt only at use, migrate existing rows and rotate historical credentials.

findings.title: Unbounded request bodies and unvalidated availability object
findings.recommendation: Enforce proxy and application body limits and validate a bounded availability schema.

findings.title: Meta OAuth client secret sent in query string
findings.recommendation: Use a form-encoded POST with timeout and fail closed when exchange fails.

findings.title: Known vulnerabilities limited to development dependencies
findings.recommendation: Migrate Tailwind and ESLint dependencies; keep dev dependencies out of runtime images.
